title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements — Delivery Window, Cancellation Fee and Delivery Disclosure Terms
content:
Each deal type of the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements** carries a delivery commitment counted from the contract date, a contract cancellation fee, a rule on open safety recalls at delivery, and, for used vehicles, the warranty box checked on the FTC Used Car Buyers Guide.

| Deal type | Delivery window (calendar days after the contract date) | Cancellation after a missed delivery window free of the cancellation fee and the non-refundable portion | Contract cancellation fee retained from the deposit (USD) | Open safety recall without a completed remedy blocks delivery | Buyers Guide warranty box |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase | 3 | yes | 150.00 | no | As Is – No Dealer Warranty |
| Used Vehicle Retail Purchase | 5 | yes | 250.00 | no | Dealer Limited Warranty |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase | 5 | yes | 250.00 | yes | Manufacturer Certified Warranty |
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase | 10 | yes | 395.00 | yes | not applicable (new vehicle) |
| New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | 7 | yes | 695.00 | yes | not applicable (new vehicle) |
| Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement | 30 | yes | 500.00 | yes | not applicable (new vehicle) |

## How the figures read
- **Delivery window.** The window is counted in calendar days after the contract date. Hypothetical: a Used Vehicle Retail Purchase contracted on the 10th of a month has a window that runs through the 15th.
- **Cancellation fee.** The fee is retained from the deposit when the buyer cancels a contracted deal that has not been delivered. Where the deal type's late-delivery waiver reads "yes", a cancellation after the delivery window has passed without delivery is free of both the fee and the non-refundable portion.
- **Recall block.** A "yes" means a vehicle with an open safety recall campaign and no completed remedy is not delivered on that deal type. A "no" means the recall does not block delivery.
- **Buyers Guide.** New vehicles carry no Buyers Guide warranty box.
